definitions.explanation: Female siblings; two or more sisters.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}には{姉妹|しまい}が{二人|ふたり}いる。
この{姉妹|しまい}はとても{仲|なか}が{良|よ}い。
examples.english: These sisters get along very well.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}と{パリ|ぱり}は{姉妹|しまい}{都市|とし}だ。{文化|ぶんか}{交流|こうりゅう}が{盛|さか}んに{行|おこな}われている。
examples.english: Tokyo and Paris are sister cities. Cultural exchanges are actively carried out between them.

notes:
{姉妹|しまい} specifically refers to female siblings (sisters).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {姉妹|しまい}{都市|とし} (sister city)
- {姉妹|しまい}{校|こう} (sister school)
- {姉妹|しまい}{会社|がいしゃ} (sister company)
- {双子|ふたご}の{姉妹|しまい} (twin sisters)

RELATED TERMS:
- {兄弟|きょうだい}: brothers; also used for "siblings" in general
- {兄弟|きょうだい}{姉妹|しまい}: siblings (gender-neutral, formal)

USAGE NOTE:
Unlike English "siblings," Japanese traditionally uses {兄弟|きょうだい} for brothers or mixed-gender siblings and {姉妹|しまい} specifically for sisters. However, {兄弟|きょうだい} is often used broadly to mean "siblings."
